text:
```yaml
name: Spellcheck

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - '**.md'
      - '**.toml'
      - '**.rs'

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  spellcheck:
    name: Spellcheck
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Run spellcheck
        uses: crate-ci/typos@master
        with:
          files: .
```
